articles.summary: New Ameriprise research explores how widowed adults are managing money, navigating financial decisions and finding support after loss For many widowed adults, managing finances independently wasn't a choice but an unexpected life transition. New research from Ameriprise Financial (NYSE: AMP) finds that many widowed Americans are moving forward with resilience despite facing one of life's most difficult transitions. Nearly nine in 10 (89%) feel financially confident, yet nearly six in 10 (58%) wish they had someone with whom they could share financial decisions. This desire for a financial sounding board highlights the value of having trusted support and guidance as widowed adults adapt to new responsibilities and make decisions about their future. The findings are part of Flying Solo: Navigating Financial Autonomy , an Ameriprise study examining how single, divorced and widowed Americans manage their finances. articles.title: Widowed Americans Are Financially Confident, Yet Many Miss a Trusted Financial Sounding Board

articles.summary: The company’s annual match campaign will help provide 5 million meals to families and individuals facing hunger For the 15 th consecutive year, Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) will match donations to Feeding America ® (up to $250,000) to support people facing hunger across the U.S. While millions of people across the country work hard to provide for themselves and their families, nearly 48 million people, including more than 14 million children, experience food insecurity. With the Ameriprise match, each dollar donated through October 31 will help provide 20 meals* to families and individuals working to build a more food-secure future. articles.summary: Colin Gates joins The Atlantic Group, a growing $2 billion Ameriprise practice led by next-generation advisors in Boca Raton, Fla. Financial advisor Colin Gates, CPWA® recently joined the branch channel of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE:AMP) from Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner Smith Inc. where he managed more than $120 million in client assets. Gates has joined The Atlantic Group , a well-established Ameriprise financial advisory practice led by founding partners and next-generation advisors Andrew Lerner, APMA™, AWMA™, CFP, ChFC® , and Logan Shalmi APMA™ in Boca Raton, Fla. As Gates evaluated the next chapter of his business, he prioritized finding a firm and team aligned with his long-term vision for clients and growth. The opportunity to join The Atlantic Group, a rapidly growing Ameriprise team led by next-generation financial advisors who share his vision for long-term growth, made the decision especially compelling.
